scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays correctly with product name, tagline, logo animation, and primary CTAs

steps.description: Navigate to the landing page URL in a browser
steps.context: Page should load within 2 seconds

steps.description: Check that the hero section contains MirDB branding, tagline, and description
steps.context: Hero section should be above the fold and immediately visible

steps.description: Confirm View on GitHub and Get Started buttons are present and functional
steps.context: CTAs should be prominently displayed and clickable

test_cases.input: Load index.html and query hero section
test_cases.expected: Hero section contains h1 with 'MirDB' text
Tagline contains 'Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol'
Logo element exists with src pointing to logo.gif or similar asset
At least two CTA buttons exist: 'View on GitHub' and 'Get Started'
Link navigates to https://github.com/yetone/mirdb in new tab

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the features section showcases key MirDB capabilities with icons, titles, and descriptions

steps.description: Navigate to the features section of the landing page
steps.context: Features section should be after hero section

steps.description: Check that all key features are displayed in a grid layout
steps.context: Should include Memcached compatibility, persistent storage, high performance, etc.

steps.description: Confirm each feature has an icon, title, and brief description
steps.context: Descriptions should be concise and technically accurate

test_cases.expected: Features section exists with at least 4 feature items
Feature card with 'Memcached' in title or description exists
Feature card mentioning 'persistent' or 'LSM-tree' exists
Feature card mentioning 'Tokio' or 'async' or 'performance' exists
Each feature card has icon/image, heading, and description text

steps.description: Scroll to the demo or usage example section
steps.context: Demo section should show practical usage examples

steps.description: Check that terminal-style code blocks are present with installation and usage commands
steps.context: Should include cargo install, server start, and client commands

steps.description: Verify copy-to-clipboard functionality works for code blocks
steps.context: Users should be able to easily copy commands

test_cases.expected: Demo section with code blocks exists
Code block contains 'cargo install mirdb' or similar installation command
Code block contains server startup command with port configuration
Usage demonstration GIF or animation is present and loads
Copy button copies code content to clipboard when clicked

scenarios.name: Getting Started Section

steps.description: Scroll to the installation/getting started area
steps.context: Should provide quick path to using MirDB

steps.description: Confirm links to full documentation are present and functional

test_cases.expected: Getting started section exists with installation instructions

Quick start code example is present showing basic usage

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Mobile
scenarios.description: Verify the landing page is fully responsive and usable on mobile devices

steps.description: View the page with mobile device dimensions (375px width)
steps.context: Testing iPhone/Android phone sizes

steps.description: Check that all content fits within viewport width
steps.context: No horizontal scrolling should be required

steps.description: Confirm CTAs and links are easily tappable
steps.context: Touch targets should be at least 44x44 pixels

steps.description: Check that text is readable without zooming
steps.context: Font sizes should be appropriate for mobile

test_cases.input: Set viewport to 375px width and load page
test_cases.expected: Page renders without horizontal overflow

test_cases.input: Check CTA button sizes on mobile
test_cases.expected: CTA buttons have minimum touch target size of 44px
Images scale to fit viewport without horizontal scroll
Navigation is accessible and usable on mobile (hamburger or visible links)

test_cases.input: Set viewport to 768px width and load page
test_cases.expected: Page renders with tablet-appropriate layout
Features display in appropriate grid (2-3 columns)

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Desktop

test_cases.expected: Page renders with desktop layout, content centered

scenarios.name: Page Load Performance
scenarios.description: Verify the page loads within acceptable performance thresholds

steps.description: Record time from navigation start to DOM content loaded
steps.context: Target is under 2 seconds per NFR-1

steps.description: Verify total transferred size of page resources
steps.context: Target is under 100KB excluding images per design spec

steps.description: Check that below-fold content is lazy loaded
steps.context: Images below fold should load on demand

test_cases.expected: DOMContentLoaded fires in under 2 seconds
HTML + CSS + JS under 100KB
Minimal render-blocking CSS/JS, critical CSS inlined or deferred loading

scenarios.name: SEO Optimization
scenarios.description: Verify the page has proper SEO meta tags and structured data

steps.description: Verify presence of essential SEO meta tags
steps.context: Title, description, keywords, Open Graph tags

steps.description: Check that heading tags follow proper hierarchy
steps.context: Single H1, logical H2/H3 structure

steps.description: Verify all images have descriptive alt text
steps.context: Important for accessibility and SEO

test_cases.expected: Title tag exists and contains 'MirDB'
Meta description exists with relevant keywords
og:title, og:description, og:image tags present
Exactly one H1 tag on the page
All img tags have non-empty alt attributes

scenarios.name: Accessibility Compliance
scenarios.description: Verify the page meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards

steps.description: Use automated tools to check WCAG compliance
steps.context: Target is WCAG 2.1 AA compliance per NFR-4

steps.description: Verify all interactive elements are keyboard accessible
steps.context: Tab order should be logical

steps.description: Verify text has sufficient contrast with background
steps.context: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text

test_cases.expected: All interactive elements have visible focus indicators
All interactive elements reachable via Tab key in logical order
Text contrast meets WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 minimum)
Interactive elements have appropriate ARIA labels where needed
Skip to main content link is available for screen readers

scenarios.name: Security Best Practices
scenarios.description: Verify the page follows security best practices for static sites

steps.description: Verify site uses HTTPS
steps.context: GitHub Pages enforces HTTPS

steps.description: Verify CDN resources use SRI hashes
steps.context: Per design spec, use Subresource Integrity

test_cases.input: Check CDN scripts have integrity attribute
